video_caption: A hand holding a marker draws on a white background, initially forming the red letters "RSA" and then completing "animate" in grey, followed by the website "www.theRSA.org" at the beginning of the video. The scene then transitions to the hand drawing "JEREMY RIFKIN" in red, followed by "THE EMPATHIC CIVILISATION" in black. Accompanying illustrations include a cartoon head with glasses, a building resembling a Greek temple with a speech bubble "I FEEL YOUR PAIN", and two calendar pages marked "2000 MAR" and "2010 MAR" below the text "OVER THE LAST 10 YEARS". The hand then adds "IN: EVOLUTIONARY BIOLOGY", "NEURO-COGNITIVE SCIENCE", "CHILD DEVELOPMENT", and "RESEARCH" in red. Greek text appears at the bottom, translating to "In the last 10 years there have been very interesting developments in Evolutionary Biology. Neurocognitive Science, Child Development, Research and many other fields...". The hand continues by writing "WHICH IS BEGINNING TO CHALLENGE" in large red letters, with a drawn flexing arm and fist, adding more Greek text that translates to "which challenge traditional perceptions we had...". Further text is written: "SOME OF THE LONG-HELD SHIBBOLETH ABOUT HUMAN JOURNEY" in black, accompanied by a cartoon of a naked man, DNA strands, and various sea creatures, with speech bubbles "EH?" and "HOLD IT!". More Greek text appears, translating to "about human nature and the meaning of the human "adventure"." Then, the hand draws a framed picture showing a monkey skeleton and a human skull, with the text "ANOTHER FRAME OF REFERENCE IS EMERGING" and "ASSUMPTIONS" in big red letters. The Greek text updates to "But there is still another scientific field emerging... and challenges these assumptions." The final part of the video shows various drawn buildings and structures representing institutions (a globe-like building, a crumbling temple-like structure, Big Ben, and the Gherkin in London), as the hand writes "EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS", "BUSINESS PRACTICES", and "GOVERNING INSTITUTIONS" in red. The accompanying Greek text translates to "And along with these, the institutions we created based on these assumptions. educational institutions, professional practices, governmental institutions etc".

A white board animation begins with a hand drawing the outline of Italy. Text appears in Greek: "Αφήστε με να σας πάω πίσω στις αρχές του '90." (Let me take you back to the early 90s.). A small laboratory building labeled "LAB" is drawn on the map, with "PARMA" below it and a flag reading "1990s" above. "GOVERNING INSTITUTIONS" is drawn in the background. The Greek text changes to: "Σε ένα μικρό εργαστήριο στην Πάρμα της Ιταλίας…" (In a small laboratory in Parma, Italy…). The hand then draws a macaque monkey sitting on a table, wearing a brain-scanning helmet. Greek text: "επιστήμονες έβαλαν ένα μαγνητικό τομογράφο εγκεφάλου MRI... σε μια μαϊμού - μακάκο... ενώ προσπαθούσε να ανοίξει ένα καρύδι." (scientists put a magnetic brain scanner MRI... on a monkey - macaque... while it was trying to open a nut.). Thought bubbles illustrate the monkey's brain activity with lines, and the Greek text "Ήθελαν να δουν πώς θα ενεργοποιηθούν οι νευρώνες." (They wanted to see how the neurons would light up.) appears. As the monkey tries to open a nut, red lines indicate neuron activation, accompanied by the Greek text: "Η μαϊμού προσπαθεί να ανοίξει το καρύδι, ενεργοποιούνται οι νευρώνες..." (The monkey is trying to open the nut, the neurons are activated...). A human enters the scene, depicted with a thought bubble saying "I'M HUNGRY" and "MMM... NUTS" as he reaches for a bowl of nuts on the table. Greek text: "...και τυχαία, -έτσι γίνεται καμιά φορά με την επιστήμη- ένας άνθρωπος μπήκε στο εργαστήριο, ίσως καταλάθος... πεινούσε, είδε τα καρύδια... και προσπάθησε να σπάσει ένα." (...and by chance - that's how science sometimes happens - a human walked into the laboratory, perhaps by mistake... he was hungry, he saw the nuts... and tried to crack one open.). The monkey's thought bubble expresses "WHO IS THIS INVADER?" as it watches the human, and the Greek text says: "Ο μακάκος σοκαρίστηκε, γιατί σκέφτηκε... Δεν κουνήθηκε, απλά κοιτούσε την προσπάθεια του ανθρώπου... όμοια με τη δική του πριν λίγο." (The macaque was totally shocked, because he thought... He didn't move, he just gazed at the human's attempt... similar to his own a moment ago.). A close-up on the monkey's surprised face appears within a screen labeled with "WHAT'S HE DOING? EATING THE HARD THINGS!". Red lines connect this screen to a laptop displaying a brain scan with a red active area, and the text "ON THE MRI THE SAME NEURONS LIGHT UP" appears. The Greek text below states: "Οι επιστήμονες κοίταξαν την τομογραφία: οι ίδιοι νευρώνες ήταν ενεργοποιημένοι... καθώς κατέγραφε τον άνθρωπο να ανοίγει το καρύδι όπως και όταν η μαϊμού το άνοιγε. Οι επιστήμονες δεν είχαν ιδέα τι συνέβαινε!" (The scientists looked at the scan: the same neurons were activated... as it recorded the human opening the nut just as the monkey opens it. The scientists had no idea what was happening!). The brain scan on the laptop now shows a question mark, emphasizing the scientists' confusion.

In this animated educational segment, a white hand draws various elements on a white background. Initially, an MRI machine is sketched, seemingly scanning a monkey, with a thought bubble above it saying "IT'S NOT ME, ALTHOUGH THE MONKEY DIDN'T TASTE THAT NICE!". A frustrated man next to the MRI machine says "STUPIDO MACHINE" and another asks "ARE YOU SICK?". Meanwhile, a man observes a computer screen, wondering "WHAT'S GOING ON?" and "HOW COULD THIS BE?". Overarching text reads "ON THE MRI THE SAME NEURONS LIGHT UP". As the scene progresses, arrows point to "OTHER PRIMATES ESPECIALLY CHIMPANZEES," followed by a drawing of a chimpanzee's head with a ruler indicating its "BIG NEO CORTEX." Subsequently, a human head is drawn with a brain inside, beside which a mirror reflects a similar brain. Text above the human drawing states "FOUND OVER & OVER MIRROR NEURONS," and below it, "HUMANS." Greek subtitles throughout the video describe the sequence of events: "Νόμιζαν ότι χάλασε ο τομογράφος." (They thought the scanner broke.), "Τότε άρχισαν να βάζουν τον τομογράφο και σε άλλα πρωτεύοντα..." (Then they started putting the scanner on other primates...), "ειδικά χιμπαντζήδες που έχουν μεγάλο νεοφλοιό." (especially chimpanzees who have a large neocortex.), "Μετά σε ανθρώπους. Αυτό που βρήκαν ξανά και ξανά..." (Then on humans. What they found again and again...), and "είναι κάτι που λέγεται κατοπτρικοί νευρώνες." (is something called mirror neurons.). The segment visually explains the discovery and implications of mirror neurons in primates, including humans.

The video features an animated whiteboard presentation about mirror neurons, starting with a man at a computer, speech bubbles asking "WHAT'S GOING ON?" and "HOW COULD THIS BE?", and humorous text "NOT ALTHOUGH MONKEY CAN'T TASTE THAT NICE!". The main title "FOUND OVER & OVER MIRROR NEURONS" is prominently displayed in red. A drawing of a chimpanzee with "OTHER PRIMATES ESPECIALLY CHIMPANZEES" and "BIG NEO CORTEX" is shown next to a human head labeled "HUMANS," which has a mirror reflecting neuron-like structures and a thought bubble saying "ARE YOU COPYING ME?". Red arrows connect the human head to the mirror. The narrator's hand then draws an elephant, a dog with a question mark, and a dolphin with a question mark, as the Greek subtitle translates to "This means that some of the primates, all humans, we suspect elephants, we are not sure about dogs and dolphins - now we are looking at it." Text confirms "WE'RE NOT SURE ABOUT DOLPHINS AND DOGS - WE'RE JUST BEGUN." Red arrows extend from the human's mirror neurons to these animals. A standing human figure is then drawn, and the hand writes, "ALL HUMANS ARE SOFT WIRED WITH MIRROR NEURONS." The Greek subtitle states, "however, all humans... we are 'wired' with mirror neurons." The scene shifts to a man with glasses, portrayed as observing various emotion icons: "ANGER," "FRUSTRATION," "SENSE OF REJECTION," and "JOY." The Greek subtitle explains, "Therefore, when I observe you, anger, disappointment... the feeling of rejection, your joy, whatever it is..." The man's head is shown with a lightbulb on top and red neuron-like structures activating inside, illustrating the concept. Text appears: "THE SAME NEURONS WILL LIGHT UP AS IF I'M HAVING THE EXPERIENCE MYSELF." The Greek subtitle concludes, "I feel what you do: the same neurons are activated in me... as if I am having the same experience as you." Finally, the man with glasses observes a distressed woman screaming "AAAAH!" with a spider crawling on her arm. Text reads, "IF I OBSERVE A SPIDER GOING UP SOMEONE'S ARM... I'M GOING TO GET A CREEPY FEELING!" The accompanying Greek subtitle confirms, "This is not unusual. We know that when a spider... walks on someone's arm and I observe it... I will get a creepy feeling."

The video segment features a hand with a black marker drawing on a white background, creating a whiteboard animation. Initially, the hand writes the English text "WE ARE SOFT WIRED TO EXPERIENCE ANOTHER'S PLIGHT AS IF WE ARE EXPERIENCING IT OURSELVES," directly above a Greek translation that reads: "να βιώνουμε την κατάσταση του άλλου σαν να τη βιώνουμε οι ίδιοι." (to experience the other's situation as if we were experiencing it ourselves.). Accompanying these words are cartoon drawings: a head with a lightbulb (representing an idea) and red dots inside, a man with glasses looking left, and a woman with her hands on her head in distress. As the video progresses, the hand adds more illustrations, including small cartoon faces labeled "ANGER," "FRUSTRATION," and "JOY," along with an English phrase "IF I OBSERVE A SPIDER GOING UP SOMEONE'S ARM I'M GOING TO GET A CREEPY FEELING." Below this, more Greek text appears, stating: "Όμως οι κατοπτρικοί νευρώνες είναι μόνο η αρχή ενός ολόκληρου φάσματος ερευνών..." (But mirror neurons are just the beginning of a whole range of research...), as the hand starts to draw another cartoon figure on the right side of the screen.

The video opens with a white whiteboard-like background, featuring a doodle-style drawing on the left side. Black and red text at the top left reads "WHAT IS EMPATHY? IT'S VERY COMPLICATED." Below, a cartoon white bird with a long beak is shown, crying out "WAAAAAA" in red text. Adjacent to the bird are three figures, depicted as heads in bowl-like structures, also crying and repeating "WAAAAAA." One of these figures has a speech bubble asking, "WHY ARE YOU CRYING?", while another responds with "I DON'T KNOW!". Below them, text reads "EMPATHIC DISTRESS IS BUILT INTO THEIR BIOLOGY." Greek subtitles at the bottom read "τα αλλα μωρα αρχιζουν να κλαινε ως απαντηση. Δεν ξερουν γιατι." (The other babies start crying in response. They don't know why.), followed by "Είναι το ενσυναισθητικό άγχος, μέρος της βιολογίας τους." (It is empathetic distress, part of their biology.) On the right side of the screen, a hand holding a black marker draws new elements. Text at the top right states "AROUND TWO & A HALF YEARS OF AGE A CHILD ACTUALLY CAN BEGIN TO RECOGNISE HIMSELF IN THE MIRROR." The hand then draws a small child sitting, holding a mirror and looking at his reflection, with a speech bubble saying "THATS ME!". A toy car and building blocks are drawn on the floor near the child. Below this, the hand draws text that reads "MATURE EMPATHY AS A CULTURAL PHENOMENON." Greek subtitles corresponding to this part say "Περίπου 2,5 χρονών ένα παιδί αρχίζει να αναγνωρίζει τον εαυτό του στον καθρέφτη." (Around 2.5 years old, a child starts to recognize themselves in the mirror.) and "Τότε ξεκινά να ωριμάζει η ενσυναίσθηση σαν πολιτισμικό φαινόμενο." (Then empathy begins to mature as a cultural phenomenon.). The drawing style is simple, black outline cartoons on a white background, with some red text for emphasis.

The video segment features a white background with a male hand drawing cartoon-style illustrations and text using a black marker. Initially, text is visible on the upper left, stating: "ONCE A TODDLER CAN IDENTIFY THEMSELVES THEN THEY KNOW THAT IF THEY'RE OBSERVING SOMEONE ELSE HAVE A FEELING, THEY KNOW IF THEY FEEL SOMETHING THEY ARE FEELING IT BECAUSE SOMEONE ELSE HAS IT. THEY ARE TWO SEPARATE BEINGS." Below this, two stick figures are shown, one with an "EW!!" thought bubble and another with "AND THAT'S GOTTA HURT" next to a car. On the upper right, the hand writes "SELFHOOD GOES TOGETHER WITH EMPATHIC DEVELOPMENT INCREASE SELFHOOD INCREASE EMPATHIC DEVELOPMENT," while a Greek subtitle appears: "Αυξάνεται η αίσθηση του εαυτού: Αυξάνεται και η ενσυναίσθηση." (The sense of self increases: Empathy also increases.) The hand then writes "AROUND EIGHT YEARS OF AGE A CHILD LEARNS ABOUT" and draws a fetus labeled "BIRTH" and a skull and crossbones labeled "& DEATH." A new Greek subtitle reads: "Περίπου 8 χρονών το παιδί μαθαίνει για τη γέννηση και το θάνατο." (Around 8 years old, the child learns about birth and death.) The drawing progresses to show a boy looking at a pregnant woman's belly, and a timeline depicting a child growing up, with text "THEY HAVE ONE & ONLY LIFE" and "AND ONE DAY THEY'RE GOING TO DIE" leading to a coffin with a deceased person inside. The Greek subtitle updates to: "από πού προήλθε ότι έχουν μόνο μία ζωή που είναι επισφαλής... και μια μέρα θα πεθάνουν." (where they came from that they have only one life which is precarious... and one day they will die.) The hand draws a paper with "LIFE IS FRAGILE & VULNERABLE" written on it and a book titled "BEING AND NOTHINGNESS" by "JEAN-PAUL SARTRE." The text "THIS IS THE BEGINNING OF AN EXISTENTIAL TRIP" appears at the bottom, with the Greek subtitle: "Αυτή είναι η αρχή ενός υπαρξιακού ταξιδιού. Γιατί μόλις το παιδί αντιλαμβάνεται όλα αυτά... συνειδητοποιεί πόσο εύθραυστη είναι η ζωή." (This is the beginning of an existential journey. Because once the child understands all this... they realize how fragile life is.) The scene transitions to a drawing of a globe with a man standing on it amidst trees, saying "IT'S TOUGH BEING ALIVE ON THIS PLANET." A fox joins the scene, responding "YOU'RE TELLING ME! HAVE YOU GOT ANY CHICKEN?" The final Greek subtitle states: "Είναι πολύ δύσκολο να είσαι ζωντανός σε αυτό τον πλανήτη, είτε είσαι ένας άνθρωπος... είτε μια αλεπού που ζει στο δάσος." (It's very difficult to be alive on this planet, whether you are a human... or a fox living in the forest.)

The video segment features a whiteboard animation where a hand draws various illustrations and text. It begins with a drawing of the Earth, depicted as a clock with hands at 12 and 6. On top of the Earth, a person stands next to a small tree and a fox-like animal. Speech bubbles above them read: "IT'S TOUGH BEING ALIVE ON THIS PLANET", "YOU'RE TELLIN' ME!", and "HAVE YOU GOT A MAP?". Below the drawing, Greek text appears: "Μόλις ένα παιδί συνειδητοποιήσει όλα αυτά..." (Once a child realizes all this...). The hand then draws a red, branching root-like structure extending from the Earth towards the standing person, and a new speech bubble above the person says, "I HAVE MY OWN UNIQUE HISTORY". A diamond shape with the text "EVERY MOMENT IS PRECIOUS" is drawn on the Earth's surface near the 3 o'clock position. The Greek text updates to: "τα χαρακτηριστικά της ζωής, τότε αρχίζει..." (the characteristics of life, then it begins...). A dashed line then emerges from the right side of the Earth, along which a small dog, followed by a larger dog, and then a person riding a horse are successively drawn. Text next to the horse and rider appears: "HAS A ONE AND ONLY LIFE.", "IT'S TOUGH TO BE ALIVE", and "THE ODDS AREN'T GOOD!". The Greek text at the bottom changes again: "να συναισθάνεται την κατάσταση κάποιου άλλου. Ότι ένα άλλο άτομο... ή άλλο πλάσμα... που είναι δύσκολη... και οι πιθανότητες δεν είναι πάντα καλές." (to empathize with someone else's situation. That another person... or another creature... that is difficult... and the odds are not always good.). Finally, a horizontal line is drawn below "EVERY MOMENT IS PRECIOUS", and the words "WE SHOW SOLIDARITY WITH OUR COMPASSION" are written beneath it. The Greek text at the bottom concludes with: "Έτσι όταν συμπάσχουμε ο ένας με τον άλλο ή με άλλα ζώα... είναι γιατί πάντα νιώθουμε τον αγώνα τους... θρηνούμε τον θάνατο και γιορτάζουμε τη ζωή και δείχνουμε αλληλεγγύη με τη συμπόνια μας." (So when we empathize with each other or with other animals... it is because we always feel their struggle... we mourn death and celebrate life and show solidarity with our compassion.). The drawing style is simple, black and white line art with occasional red accents, resembling a whiteboard animation.

The video segment displays a whiteboard animation featuring hand-drawn figures and text on a white background. At the top, in red capital letters, the phrase "EMPATHY IS THE OPPOSITE OF UTOPIA" is prominently displayed. Below this, two stick-figure angels with halos and wings are depicted, each standing on a cloud-like shape. The cloud on the left reads "THERE IS NO EMPATHY", while the one on the right says "IN HEAVEN". On the far right, a stick-figure person with a head full of thought bubbles stands on a circular shape representing Earth, with the number "9" visible on its surface; a speech bubble next to the person states "I HAVE MY OWN UNIQUE HISTORY". A red, branching line extends from the person towards the "IN HEAVEN" cloud. As the video progresses, a hand is seen writing additional text beneath the "IN HEAVEN" cloud: first, "BECAUSE THERE IS NO MORTALITY", followed by "NO SUFFERING". Greek subtitles are present at the bottom of the screen, changing with the spoken dialogue: "Δεν υπάρχει ενσυναίσθηση στον παράδεισο, σας το εγγυώμαι πριν πάτε εκεί." (There is no empathy in heaven, I guarantee it before you go there.); then, "Αφού εκεί δεν υπάρχει θνητότητα." (Since there is no mortality there.); and finally, "Αφού στην ουτοπία δεν υπάρχουν βάσανα." (Since there is no suffering in utopia.).

The video segment opens with a whiteboard drawing illustrating concepts around "UTOPIA." Text at the top reads "ENEMY OF UTOPIA" in red, with speech bubbles showing an angel's confusion about "DEATH" ("HAVE YOU SEEN DEATH? BIG FELLA. SKULL. WEARS A LOT OF BLACK." and "mmm... CAN'T SAY I HAVE. HIS NAME DOESN'T RING ANY BELLS!"). Further down, red text in speech bubbles states "THERE IS NO EMPATHY," "IN HEAVEN," "BECAUSE THERE IS NO MORTALITY," and "NO SUFFERING." A thought bubble on the right says "I HAVE MY OWN UNIQUE HISTORY." As the video progresses, the scene transitions to a new drawing. The hand continues to draw, adding "NO SUFFERING" in a cloud, a ladder extending downwards, and a Grim Reaper-like figure with a scythe. A small cartoon person is being flipped into the air by the scythe, and the text "EMPATHY IS GROUNDED IN THE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF DEATH & THE CELEBRATION OF LIFE" appears in red. An image of the Earth with clock numbers (9, 6) is seen on the right, and a thought bubble reads "NICE DODGE FOXY!" Throughout this segment, Greek subtitles are present, first stating "Η ενσυναίσθηση βασίζεται στην αναγνώριση του θανάτου και τον εορτασμό της ζωής" (Empathy is based on the recognition of death and the celebration of life), and then adding "και στην αλληλοϋποστήριξη: να ανθίσουμε και να υπάρχουμε" (and on mutual support: to flourish and to exist).

A drawing hand sketches a cartoon man holding a smartphone and a coffee cup, identified by accompanying text as "Modern Man," while Greek text at the bottom states "Είμαστε ο “Ενσυναισθητικός” Άνθρωπος. Οπότε ιδού το ερώτημα." (We are the “Empathic” Human. So here is the question.). The hand writes "WE ARE HOMO-EMPATHICUS" and "HOW DOES CONSCIOUSNESS CHANGE IN HISTORY?" above the man, whose brain is depicted with connections to "APPS," "FOOTBALL," and "COFFEE." Subsequently, a "Medieval Serf" with an axe and a castle background is drawn, his brain linked to "FOOD," "SOCIAL POSITION," and "GOD." Finally, a "Forager Hunter" from "30,000 YEARS AGO" is illustrated, his brain connected to "BELONGING," "SEX," "FOOD," and "SHELTER." The Greek text at the bottom changes to reflect this historical evolution of consciousness: "Η συνειδητότητα αλλάζει μέσα στην ιστορία. Η "καλωδίωση" του εγκεφάλου μας σήμερα είναι διαφορετική από κάποιον το μεσαίωνα. Αντίστοιχα, και η δική του είναι διαφορετική σε σχέση με κάποιον 30.000 χρόνια πριν." (Consciousness changes throughout history. The "wiring" of our brain today is different from someone in the Middle Ages. Correspondingly, his own is different compared to someone 30,000 years ago.). The hand then writes, "IS IT POSSIBLE WE CAN EXTEND OUR EMPATHY?" as the Greek text at the bottom poses, "Το ερώτημα που έθεσα αρχικά, πριν από 6 χρόνια είναι: Πώς η συνείδηση αλλάζει μέσα στην Ιστορία. Θέτω την ακόλουθη πρόταση: είναι δυνατόν... αφού είμαστε καλωδιωμένοι για ενσυναισθητικό άγχος..." (The question I asked originally, 6 years ago, is: How does consciousness change in History? I propose the following: is it possible... since we are soft wired for empathetic distress...). A large red hand-like shape extends from the modern man's head, first encompassing "OUR FELLOW CREATURES" (a fox and rabbits) and the "HUMAN RACE" (stylized figures), and then reaching around a drawing of "BIOSPHERE / COMMON COMMUNITY" (the Earth). The Greek text completes this thought, asking "να επεκτείνουμε την ενσυναίσθησή μας προς όλο το ανθρώπινο γένος: Σαν μια μεγάλη οικογένεια. Και προς τα υπόλοιπα μέλη της εξελικτικής μας οικογένειας... και προς την βιόσφαιρα σαν την κοινή μας γειτονιά;" (to extend our empathy to the entire human race: As a large family. And to the rest of the members of our evolutionary family... and to the biosphere as our common neighborhood?). The video concludes with the hand writing "IF ITS IMPOSSIBLE TO IMAGINE THEN I CAN'T SEE HOW WE ARE GOING TO MAKE IT!" next to the Earth, while the Greek text reads, "Αν μπορούμε να το φανταστούμε αυτό... τότε ίσως σώσουμε το είδος μας και τον πλανήτη μας. Και αν δεν μπορείτε ούτε να το φανταστείτε αυτό..." (If we can imagine that... then perhaps we can save our species and save our planet. And if you can't even imagine that...).

A hand draws on a white board, illustrating concepts related to empathy and communication. Initially, the board shows text like "CONSCIOUSNESS," "IS IT POSSIBLE WE CAN EXTEND OUR EMPATHY?", and "COFFEE." A red line extends from a drawn head, forming a hand labeled "EMPATHY IS THE INVISIBLE HAND," reaching towards a drawing of the Earth, labeled "BIOSPHERE." Text below the head says "OUR FELLOW CREATURES," pointing to a small animal. Greek text translates the speaker's words: "Η ενσυναίσθηση μας επιτρέπει... να επεκτείνουμε την ευαισθησία μας προς κάποιον άλλο και να φτιάξουμε μεγάλες, συνεκτικές κοινωνικές ομάδες. Η ενσυναίσθηση είναι εκπολιτισμός. Ο εκπολιτισμός είναι ενσυναίσθηση." (Empathy allows us... to extend our sensibility towards another and create large, cohesive social groups. Empathy is civilization. Civilization is empathy.)

The scene transitions to another drawing illustrating "NATURE." A hand draws a caveman-like figure shouting, with a speech bubble saying "SHOUTING DISTANCE! HEY!". Text states "COMMUNICATION ONLY EXTENDED TO LOCAL TRIBE." Red lines connect to the caveman's head, pointing to "BELONGING," "SEX," "FOOD," and "SHELTAR." Another caveman-like figure points towards a mountain with a UFO and an alien on top, labeled "ALIENS." Text below the pointing figure states "EMPATHY ONLY EXTENDED TO BLOOD TIES." The Greek translation adds: "Στις πρωτόγονες κοινωνίες η επικοινωνία περιοριζόταν... στην τοπική φυλή. Πέρα από το απέναντι βουνό βρισκόταν ο ξένος-παρεισάκτος. Οπότε η ενσυναίσθηση περιοριζόταν σε δεσμούς αίματος." (In primitive societies communication was limited... to the local tribe. Beyond the opposite mountain was the alien-intruder. So empathy was limited to blood ties.)

The next scene shows the hand writing "HYDRAULIC AGRICULTURAL CIVILISATIONS" in red. Text explains that "SCRIPT ALLOWED US TO EXTEND THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM." Two figures are drawn interacting on a circular platform, representing "ANNIHILATE TIME & SPACE BRING PEOPLE TOGETHER." A slice of pizza is shown nearby, and text below reads "HERE'S THE GRAIN YOU ORDERED." Greek text translates: "Περνώντας στον αρδευτικό-αγροτικό πολιτισμό, με τη γραφή επεκτείναμε... το κεντρικό νευρικό σύστημα, μειώσαμε τις αποστάσεις φέρνοντας πιο πολλούς ανθρώπους κοντά." (Moving to the irrigation-agricultural civilization, with writing we extended... the central nervous system, we reduced distances by bringing more people closer.)

Finally, the hand writes "MODERN MAN" and "THEOLOGICAL CONSCIOUSNESS" in red. It also writes "DE TRIBALISE & BEGAN ASSOCIATIONS WITH RELIGIOUS TIES." Drawings appear: two Jewish men talking, labeled "JEWS"; two Christian men, one conversing with a lion-like figure wearing a cross tie and asking "CAN'T A GUY REPENT?"; and two Muslim men talking. Greek text clarifies: "Και η διαφοροποίηση των ικανοτήτων και η αύξηση της ατομικότητας... όχι μόνο οδήγησε στην θεολογική συνείδηση αλλά η ενσυναίσθηση μας έφτασε σε μια νέα αφήγηση. Αντί να συνδεόμαστε μόνο με τους δεσμούς αίματος... φύγαμε από τη φυλή και ξεκινήσαμε να συνδεόμαστε με θρησκευτικούς δεσμούς.
